venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.notes_summary: **EV — Saturday 1/17.** Prior night (1/16) did 31 investor cocktails plus 85 in investor discount, so volume was more like an $8,000 night. Tonight: quite slow open and close with a decent 8:30-11:30 peak; low large-party night (lots of trios), betting on large parties did not pay off, but spirits were high. Peak table: a first-time LES trio spending over $500 who capped off with cookies and three dunking agents. Top sellers: Masari, Root & Rye, Revenant. Comps $122.27. Door: filled the whole room at 6:30, four solos seated together, 3s early then 2s on the waitlist at 8pm (never long); Tock/iPads buggy at points; familiar faces, employee friends, regulars, and guests after a funeral; died down an hour before last call. No no-shows. Kitchen: great job again.

venues.name: D&C DC
venues.notes_summary: **DC — Saturday 1/17.** Busy night on a 3-day weekend with a surge in reservations. Private event in the Garden early (Dana and Will, very happy, rave reviews especially for Jada); extended 30 minutes, public reopened ~9 on individual tabs. Marquee fully sat with a long waitlist; Garden packed standing-room 9-11pm; pre-batched product ran low and a few items were 86'd. Some late reservations arrived without messaging and were moved to the Garden wait. Room full through midnight; in the hustle a few things fell through the cracks. Kitchen: nearly 12% of sales; event food well received and guests ordered more off the BEO menu; popcorn sold out. MOD: Josh / Cory.
